text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a while after the tryouts, Daiwa Scarlet
was constantly
approached by trainers
attempting to scout her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What, is nobody going to talk to
Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I've set my sights on Vodka. No matter
how much potential Scarlet
has, her
personality is going to make things
difficult...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you have a point there. Guess I'll try
speaking to Vodka too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, now that's more like it! The
annoying crowd's gone, so I can
finally
focus on my training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At least, that's what I'd like to say. Hey!
What are you still doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, could it be that you still think
I'm a perfect honor student
who'll listen to
whatever you say?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Since you're still here, I'll let you in on a secret. It was all an act.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the real me! And like those guys
from earlier said—I'm
stubborn, selfish,
and short-tempered.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well? Your dreams crushed yet? Good,
then scurry along, shoo.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What? Were you even listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying I'm not the good girl you think I
am! Get it into that thick
head of yours
already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's packed with fast
runners! And me, I'm the one who
decided
to put on airs, get cocky, and then lose
pathetically!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What do you know?! I don't need your
pity!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because... I get it. All I do is mouth off
about being the "number one
this", the
"number one that"—but it's all talk—it's
not real!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I lost to Vodka once, and here I am
wallowing in self-pity and going
on
reckless training runs... Even I know that
I'm being unreasonable!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... what else can I do?! If I'm not
number one, then how can I even
face
myself?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I have to be number one in speed, in
strength! Number one in
popularity, in
fans—and I won't settle for anything else!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't be satisfied unless I'm all of those
things. That's the kind of
person I am, take
it or leave it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To stay true to myself—I have to keep on
being number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold up. You're saying that after listening to my rant... Are you really that clueless?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Take a hint, pal! I told you, I'm a stubborn
girl who's obsessed with
being number
one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tch, what's your problem! Why're you still
trying to scout me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll say this now, but I'm not going to just
nod my head and listen to
everything you
say, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And if I don't like your training menu, I
won't stop bugging you about
it! Are you
willing to deal with all of that?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-what the heck is with you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Saying you want to support me... that we'll
do this together... Hey,
were you serious
about all that?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Could you not steal my
catchphrase like that?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Geez... Looks like I've been scouted... by a real weirdo. Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet bursts into tears, as if she's
been freed from the heavy
burdens
weighing her down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how long it's been since I cried in
front of someone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Not really in the mood to run anymore. I guess I should head back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I've been feeling sluggish
recently. So I think... I'll tuck in
early for
once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Daiwa Scarlet walks away, I notice that
she's lost the spirit she
once had. Looks
like the second place finish at the tryouts
really did
a number on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still brainstorming ways to get her
confidence back, I decide to pay
the
cafeteria a visit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yoohoo, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's just Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya mean, JUST?! ...You okay Vodka? You've got this bored look on your face lately.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not really... You're just imaginin' things.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's just... Recently, she's always walkin'
around with that dumb look
on her face...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: She? Oh, you mean Scarlet? She's your roommate and rival, after all. 'Course you'd worry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not—We're not like that...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you're right, she's been pretty down in
the dumps. I wonder if
losing to you at the
tryouts was a big shock for her?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Y'know, I just didn't think she was the
type to give up this easily.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Forget it. Whatever, one less rival
for me to worry about. Catch
ya later.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey Vodka, wait up! I said waaait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I might have the perfect solution to
all this.
